name: Dilation
description: Warps time within %range% tile for %duration% turns. Enemies caught in the field have their ability cooldowns frozen, their buffs tick away twice as fast, and their debuffs linger twice as long.

upgrade.summary: Becomes a passive - the field never switches off.
upgrade.description: Warps time permanently within %range% tile. Enemies caught in the field have their ability cooldowns frozen, their buffs tick away twice as fast, and their debuffs linger twice as long.
details: There is nothing to cast and nothing to time - the field simply follows this unit.
